title: Generic append-only log FD continuation
goal: Graduate only a narrow generic append-only regular-file file-descriptor continuation class after the wave 2 baseline has already proven exact refusal for writable and append-only candidates. The accepted shape must be same-Machinen-Debian-base and target-native: an observed regular-file fd opened with O_APPEND, stable path and identity, safe EOF/offset semantics, no locks, no mmap, no inotify/fanotify, no unmodeled peer resources, and visible target append progress after loader launch. Non-append writable fds and unsafe append variants must continue to refuse before target loader launch or with targetPid=null.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the descriptor/capture schema records append-only regular-file fd candidates distinctly from non-append writable fds, including fd number, path, access flags, current offset, EOF/size evidence, dev/inode/mtime descriptor evidence, sha256 or prefix identity evidence, and append policy.
proofChecklist.evidence: Descriptor/capture schema now records append-only candidates distinctly from non-append writable fds. packages/runtime/src/move-pid-graph.ts includes regularFiles[].access="append-only" alongside append-only-refused/read-write-refused and cursor.policy="append-only-end". packages/cli/src/move-generic-wave2-baseline.ts computes append-only access only when O_APPEND is set and captured offset equals captured file size, while preserving fd/path/flags/offset and identity dev/inode/size/mtimeEpochSeconds/sha256. Focused test packages/cli/src/__tests__/move-generic-resource-graph.test.ts proves an O_APPEND fd at offset=size records access=append-only and cursor policy append-only-end, while an O_APPEND fd at offset!=size records append-only-refused. Validation: focused Vitest 4 files / 99 tests passed in 1.730s; pnpm run typecheck passed in 3.651s; pnpm run format:check passed after formatting in 1.415s.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the classifier accepts only exact append-only log fd shapes and refuses non-append writable fds, read-write overwrite/truncate ambiguity, missing/deleted paths, unsupported flags, and unknown access modes with exact evidence.
proofChecklist.evidence: Classifier now accepts only the exact first append-only shape and keeps unsafe writable shapes refused. packages/cli/src/move-generic-wave2-baseline.ts returns no appendOnlyRegularFileCursor refusal only for regular file resources with O_APPEND, write access, captured FILE_IDENTITY evidence, and resource.offset == captured file.size. Focused tests prove exact O_APPEND-at-EOF has no appendOnlyRegularFileCursor refusal; O_APPEND offset mismatch refuses as appendOnlyRegularFileCursor; non-append writable r+ shape refuses as writableRegularFileCursor; deleted regular-file fd refuses as regularFileDeleted. Unknown/unsupported write flags continue to fall through writableRegularFileCursor unless they satisfy the exact O_APPEND-at-EOF contract. currentEvidence.summary: Inspected current wave 2 append-only refusal implementation and regular-file cursor loader before implementing support. Current state: packages/cli/src/move-generic-wave2-baseline.ts detects O_APPEND writable regular-file fds with fd flags, records descriptor access=append-only-refused and cursor.policy=append-only-end, then emits refusalClass appendOnlyRegularFileCursor. genericResourceGraphLoaderCommand refuses immediately when genericResourceGraphState.refusalClasses is non-empty, so no append candidate can currently reach the target loader. packages/cli/src/move-generic-file-cursor-loader.ts reconstructs only read-only regular files: target preflight validates file exists, size, and sha256; loader opens O_RDONLY, lseeks to captured offset, dup2s to the target fd, and execvp launches target argv. Existing local/remote wave2 baseline rows prove append-only candidates refuse with loaderStarted=false, but no append-only support loader or support matrix row exists yet.
currentEvidence.designedContract: Narrow support should add a distinct accepted append access state (for example append-only) while preserving append-only-refused for unsafe candidates. Accepted shape should require a regular existing non-deleted path, O_APPEND set, write access, captured fd number/flags/offset/size/dev/inode/mtime/sha256 descriptor evidence, target preflight full size+sha256 equality before launch, no fileLock/mmapFile/inotify/fanotify/unsupported resource refusals, and no non-append writable ambiguity. The target loader should open accepted files with O_WRONLY|O_APPEND, dup2 them to captured fd numbers, exec target-native argv, and require visible post-load append progress evidence in the support row. Refusals should cover stale/truncated/rotated/missing target log, offset/EOF mismatch if the chosen contract requires captured offset==size, non-append writable fd, unsupported flags, lock/mmap/inotify/fanotify interactions, and any concurrent-writer ambiguity that cannot be made exact.

Updated the generic regular-file cursor loader so accepted append-only fds are reconstructed with os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, lseek, dup2, and execvp; read-only fd behavior remains O_RDONLY. Focused tests prove accepted append descriptor/cursor state, offset-mismatch refusal, non-append writable refusal, deleted fd refusal, and O_APPEND in the generated loader command.
